itens.titulo: Palantir raises full-year revenue outlook as US commercial sales top US government revenue for the first time
itens.descricao: Palantir raises full-year revenue outlook as US commercial sales top US government revenue for the first time Yahoo Finance
trechos: Palantir reported Q3 revenue of $2.313 billion, a 96% increase from the previous year.
Wall Street had expected revenue of $2.17 billion, according to Bloomberg data.
Palantir now sees full-year revenue between $8.530 billion and $8.534 billion, topping analyst estimates of $8.2 billion.
The company also raised its US commercial sales target to more than $3.559 billion.
Adjusted earnings per share of $0.44 also beat consensus estimates of $0.40.
What else you need to know: Palantir stock is up roughly 2% year to date, even as the company has been caught in the recent tech sell-off.

itens.titulo: The Intel stock collapse is getting worse — and the $3.5 trillion chip rout is spreading
itens.descricao: The Intel stock collapse is getting worse — and the $3.5 trillion chip rout is spreading Yahoo Finance
trechos: About 7 in 10 S&P 500 stocks rose Monday, yet nearly every chip stock fell, and the group shed more than $400 billion in market value in a single session, by Yahoo Finance calculations.
The chipmaker slid about 9% after its worst day since 1974 on Oct.
30, when a disappointing forecast knocked nearly 29% off the stock.
Micron (MU), Sandisk (SNDK), Seagate (STX), and Western Digital (WDC) — the memory and storage names that led the chip boom this year — all got clobbered, falling roughly 6% to 8%.
Marvell (MRVL) fell even harder, a drop that came as it agreed to buy Lumentum (LITE) in a $115 billion deal.
Nvidia (NVDA) held up better than most, but it's still down about 16% since Oct.
Chip and memory stocks have lost about $3.7 trillion in market value since Oct.
